hooks.name: Hugo Version Sync Check
hooks.description: Verifies that the locally installed Hugo version matches the version defined in .github/workflows/deploy.yml. Run before pushing to prevent CI build failures.

action.command: LOCAL_VERSION=$(hugo version 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1); CI_VERSION=$(grep -m1 'HUGO_VERSION:' .github/workflows/deploy.yml | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+'); PREVIEW_VERSION=$(grep -m1 'HUGO_VERSION:' .github/workflows/preview.yml | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+'); echo "Local Hugo:   $LOCAL_VERSION"; echo "deploy.yml:   $CI_VERSION"; echo "preview.yml:  $PREVIEW_VERSION"; if [ "$LOCAL_VERSION" != "$CI_VERSION" ] || [ "$LOCAL_VERSION" != "$PREVIEW_VERSION" ]; then echo ''; echo '❌ VERSION MISMATCH — update workflows before pushing'; exit 1; else echo ''; echo '✅ All Hugo versions in sync'; fi
